links.evidence: Multiple gold/teal circular coin icons with dollar-sign ($) glyphs are scattered around the phone and platform, orbiting via directional arrows.

File resides in drawable-nodpi (density-independent illustration assets, typical for large onboarding artwork) and is named 'onboarding_security', strongly implying it is the hero image for a security/privacy-themed onboarding step in the Kivo app's intro flow.
Image shows a teal/coral shield icon with a gold padlock and sparkle accents, positioned top-right of the composition.

The phone mockup shows a generic dashboard UI (chart, profile icon, nav bar) with no visible login form; it is unclear whether this specifically illustrates the app's 'no bank credentials requested' policy or is simply a generic finance-app dashboard graphic reused from a stock illustration set.

The image's coral and teal color scheme visually matches the Kivo brand palette documented in the project CLAUDE.md (coral #F56565/#FC8181, teal #2C7A7B, crema #FEFCF5), suggesting deliberate brand-consistent asset design rather than a generic stock illustration.

A shield-and-padlock motif is a standard UX symbol for security/privacy reassurance; combined with the filename 'onboarding_security.jpg' and its location in an onboarding-oriented drawable set, it is very likely used on an onboarding screen communicating that Kivo protects the user's financial data without requesting bank credentials.
The phone's screen shows a bar chart with ascending teal/coral bars and a diagonal arrow trending upward with sparkle/star decorations, representing financial growth.

The rising chart and coins on the phone screen visually pair the app's core value proposition (automatic financial tracking/growth) with the security shield, suggesting the onboarding slide communicates 'your finances grow safely, without exposing bank credentials.'
